welcome_ubbc:
🍺 Welcome to UBBC Bot!

📋 General:
/start - Show this help
/help [section] - Show help for specific section
/cancel - Cancel pending operation

🛍️ Orders:
/list_offers [user] - View available offers (admin: add 'user' for customer view)
/order <offer_id> [quantity] - Place an order
/confirm_order <offer_id> <quantity> - Confirm duplicate order
/my_orders [id] - View your orders

🔔 Notifications:
/subscribe - Subscribe to offer notifications
/unsubscribe - Unsubscribe from notifications
admin_sections_available:
👑 Admin sections available: suppliers, offers, orders, users
Use /help [section] for detailed commands

📚 Help Sections:

help_general:
📋 General Commands:

/start - Show main help
/help [section] - Show help for specific section
/cancel - Cancel pending operation
/list_offers [filter] - View offers (filters: all, draft, active, sold_out, completed, inactive, archived, user)

/unsubscribe - Unsubscribe from notifications

help_orders:
🛍️ Order Commands:

/order <offer_id> [quantity] - Place an order
/confirm_order <offer_id> <quantity> - Confirm duplicate order
/my_orders [id] - View your orders
/payment_info - View payment details for pending orders

help_suppliers:
🏢 Supplier Management:

/create_supplier <name> - Create supplier
/archive_supplier <name> - Archive supplier
/list_suppliers [active|retired|all] - List suppliers
/update_supplier <name> - Update supplier details

/update_supplier_full_name <id> <name> - Update supplier full name
help_offers:
🍺 Offer Management:

/create_offer <supplier> <name> <price> <box_size> - Create draft offer
/instant_order <supplier> <name> <price> <customer> [box_size] - Create an offer and an order at once
/view_offer <offer_id> - View and edit offer details

/update_offer_price <offer_id> <price> - Update offer price
/update_offer_description <offer_id> <desc> - Update offer description
/preview_offer <offer_id> - Preview offer appearance
/publish_offer <offer_id> - Publish draft offer
/cancel_offer <offer_id> - Cancel offer and all orders
/delete_offer <offer_id> - Delete completed or inactive offer
/create_box <offer_id> - Add box to offer
/list_boxes [active|ordered|full|delivered|all|help] - View box status
/audit_offer <offer_id> - Audit offer capacity vs orders
/refill_boxes <offer_id> - Move orders into the room of earlier boxes
/process_wholesale <offer_id> - Start wholesale ordering process
help_users:
👥 User Management:

/list_pending - View users awaiting approval
/list_users [approved|unauthorized|rejected|all|subscribers] - View customers (default: all)
/create_guest <first_name> [last_name] [contact] - Add guest user
/list_guests - View guest users
/credit <username> <amount> [reason] - Issue credit (negative: charge, with a reason)
/list_credits - Customers with credit or a negative balance
/approve_user <username> - Approve user
/reject_user <username> - Reject user
/user_status <username> - Check user status
/update_user <username|customer_id> <first_name> [last_name] - Update name

/update_user_last_name <id> <name> - Update customer last name
/delete_user <username|customer_id> - Delete a customer (only without open orders or credit balance)

/order_for <username> <offer_id> [quantity] - Place order for user
/cancel_order [username|order_id] - Cancel customer order
/edit_order <order_id> - Edit an order's box, unit price or status
/list_user_orders [username] - View orders for user
/list_offer_orders [offer_id] - View all orders for offer
/export_orders [status] - Download CSV (full=all fields)
/audit_orders - Audit orders - add update_date to orders missing it
help_delivery:
📦 Delivery Management:

/process_delivery - Process wholesale deliveries (includes 'Complete Delivery' option for all boxes)
/process_labeling - Complete labeling process
/send_delivery_overviews - Send delivery overviews to customers
/process_payment - Mark customers as paid (all, or the amount received)
/list_open_payments - Customers with unpaid orders and their age
/send_payment_reminder - Send payment reminder to customers
/failed_notifications - Labeled orders without a delivery overview yet
help_import:
📥 Import Workflow:

/offer_status <offer_id> <import|active|soldout|completed> - Change offer status
/import_orders - Import orders from CSV file
/finalize_import <offer_id> - Finalize imported offer
help_system:
⚙️ System Maintenance:

/setup_test_data - Setup test data (test environment only)

data_export_readme:
Your data from the UBBC Bot
===========================
Exported on: {exported_at}
Customer ID: {customer_id}

Files
-----
- profile.json: your customer record (name, username, language, status, subscription, contact details).
- orders.json: your orders, with the offer name added.
- credit.json: your credit balance and credit transactions. The administrator who made a transaction is left out.
- purchase_history.json: the purchase events we keep for bookkeeping. delete_after is the date they are removed automatically.

Notes
-----
- Amounts are written as text with two decimals, for example "2.50", so no precision is lost.
- Dates and times are in UTC (ISO 8601).

Not included
------------
- Data that Telegram itself keeps about you.
- Technical logs (kept for 7 days, they only contain your Telegram user ID) and short-lived message tracking records.
- Data about other people.

You can request this export once every 30 days with /my_data. See /privacy for your other rights, including deletion.

usage_report_top_customers:
Usage: /report_top_customers [period] [anon]

Period: YYYY (that year), YYYY-MM-DD (from that date until now) or YYYY-MM-DD YYYY-MM-DD (from–to, inclusive). Default: this year. With anon: made-up names instead of the real ones.
usage_report_sales_by_period:
Usage: /report_sales_by_period [period] [day|week|month|weekday] [paid]

Period: YYYY (that year), YYYY-MM-DD (from that date until now) or YYYY-MM-DD YYYY-MM-DD (from–to, inclusive). Default: this year. Per month by default; with weekday per day of the week, with the average per occurrence of that day in the period. Orders placed, or with paid: payments received.
usage_report_customer:
Usage: /report_customer <name_username_or_customer_id> [period]

Period: YYYY (that year), YYYY-MM-DD (from that date until now) or YYYY-MM-DD YYYY-MM-DD (from–to, inclusive). Default: this year.
admin_reports_menu:
📊 Reports

Purchase reports for this year. For another period, use the commands (see /help reports).
enter_customer_for_report: 👤 Which customer? Send a name, username or customer ID, optionally followed by a period (YYYY, YYYY-MM-DD or two dates).
help_reports:
📊 Reports:

/report_top_customers [period] [anon] - Top customers by amount paid (with anon: made-up names)
/report_sales_by_period [period] [day|week|month|weekday] [paid] - Orders (with paid: payments) per day, week, month or day of the week
/report_customer <customer> [period] - Paid per month and open order amount of one customer

Period: YYYY (that year), YYYY-MM-DD (from that date until now) or YYYY-MM-DD YYYY-MM-DD (from–to, inclusive). Default: this year. Dates are in Dutch time.
